decision.summary: A confirmed temporary offset begins at index 625 with sharp multi-axis jump (N↑, E↑, U↓) and sustains through 645. Subsequent intervals (646–729) show complex, non-reversing behavior: U trends downward while E/N fluctuate, with opposing cross-axis trends (e.g., 660–670, 690–700) but no full return on any axis. No permanent step is isolated within the offset; superposed motion is evident but does not resolve into a clean return. All post-645 intervals are uncertain due to ambiguous or absent opposing returns.

intervals.observation: N rises sharply at 625 (from ~1.8 to ~14), E jumps from ~-0.6 to ~1.4, U drops from ~-21.6 to ~-13.8; N/E/U remain elevated and relatively stable through 645 (N≈13–15, E≈0.7–3.5, U≈-14 to -15.8), forming a plateau-like segment with minor fluctuations but no opposing return — consistent with a temporary offset onset and sustained interior.

From 646 onward, U begins a gradual descent (e.g., -15.8 → -17.6 by 660), while E rises (e.g., ~1.4 → ~4.0) and N stays elevated (~13–15); around 660–665, U dips further (-18.7) while E peaks (~4.5), then both reverse trend partially (U recovers to ~-17.5, E drops to ~2.5 by 670). No clear opposing return on all axes; cross-axis trends oppose without full recovery — status uncertain.

Between 671–700, U continues fluctuating (-17.5 to -19.4), E varies (1.5–4.5), N remains high (12–15.7); no coherent return toward pre-625 baseline. A local dip in U at ~690 coincides with E rise, but neither axis shows sustained reversal. Return not observed — status uncertain.

From 701 to 729, values remain elevated relative to pre-625 (N≈12–15, E≈1.5–4.3, U≈-16 to -18.6); no evidence of return to original level. Final samples (725–729) show slight U rise and E drop but still far from pre-625 state. Return unobserved — status uncertain.
